Compare prediction errors on paired observations

Source: R/stats_prediction_views.R
compare_predictions.Rd

Compares each person's model with its pooled counterpart or with a mean baseline at the same scope. Only pairs evaluated on identical observations are compared. Positive gain indicates improvement over the reference.

Usage

compare_predictions(
  x,
  reference = c("pooled", "mean"),
  metric = "rmse",
  model = NULL,
  scope = "individual",
  subject = NULL
)

Arguments

x

An idiographic fit.

reference

"pooled" or "mean".

metric

A metric column, such as "rmse" or "accuracy".

model, scope, subject

Optional filters for the models being compared.

Value

A data frame with one row per paired person/model comparison, including value, reference_value, and gain.

Examples

fit <- fit_ml(srl, y = "effort", x = "efficacy", id = "name",
              time = "day", scope = "both", model = c("mean", "ridge"))
compare_predictions(fit, reference = "pooled", model = "ridge")
